title: Extension-by-zero criterion for Noetherian cohomology
statement: Let X be a topological space and d\geq 0 an integer. Assume (1) X is quasi-compact, (2) the quasi-compact opens form a basis of X, (3) the intersection of two quasi-compact opens is quasi-compact, and (4) H^p(X,j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_U)=0 for all p>d and every quasi-compact open j:U \to X, where \underline{\mathbf Z}_U is the constant abelian sheaf on U [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and j_! is extension by zero [lem-sc-topological-extension-by-zero-stalks]. Then H^p(X,F)=0 for all p>d and every abelian sheaf F on X [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

source.place: Lemma 02UX (cohomology-lemma-vanishing-reduction), in the proof of Proposition 02UZ

proof.text: For each finite set A of sections of F over quasi-compact opens, let F_A be the subsheaf generated by A. The finite subsets form a filtered poset. Every germ of F belongs to some F_A, and a germ equal to zero in F is already zero in one such F_A after enlarging A; hence the canonical map colim_A F_A \to F is an isomorphism on every stalk and therefore an isomorphism of sheaves. By [lem-sc-topological-filtered-cohomology] with U=X, H^p(X,F)=colim_A H^p(X,F_A), so it suffices to treat sheaves generated by finitely many such sections.

If F is generated by n sections, let F' be generated by the first n-1. The short exact sequence 0 \to F' \to F \to F/F' \to 0 and the long exact cohomology sequence from [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] show, by induction on n with the zero sheaf as base case, that vanishing above d for F' and F/F' implies it for F. Since F/F' is generated by one section, it remains to treat the one-section case.

A sheaf generated by one section over a quasi-compact open U is a quotient j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_U \to F. For its kernel sequence 0 \to K \to j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_U \to F \to 0, write K as the filtered colimit of its subsheaves K_\lambda generated by finitely many sections over quasi-compact opens, and put F_\lambda=(j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_U)/K_\lambda. Exactness of filtered colimits in abelian sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-site-abelian-sheaves-filtered-colimits-exact] identifies F with colim_\lambda F_\lambda. Applying [lem-sc-topological-filtered-cohomology] reduces the vanishing of H^p(X,F) to the case that K is finitely generated; the long exact sequence then reduces it to vanishing of H^q(X,K) for q>d.

source.place: Lemma 02UX, proof, paragraphs beginning 'These sheaves are exactly' and 'Assume now'

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-constant-subsheaf-finite-filtration] to the finitely generated K. Every successive quotient Q fits into 0 \to j'_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_V \to j_!\underline{\mathbf Z}_W \to Q \to 0. The hypothesis gives vanishing of both outer sheaves in degrees >d, and the long exact sequence gives H^p(X,Q)=0 for p>d. Induction along the finite filtration gives H^p(X,K)=0 for p>d.

source.place: Lemma 02UX, proof, final paragraph using Lemma 0A38

proof.text: The preceding reductions establish the vanishing for every finitely generated F_A, and Step 1 passes it to F by the filtered-colimit isomorphism. Thus H^p(X,F)=0 for all p>d.
